capabilities: Capitalize the first letter of a word when it starts a sentence, on the word-ending keystroke
Correct two-initial-capital typos with a configurable exceptions list
Convert hyphens into en or em dashes based on surrounding spaces
Undo a single correction with one Cmd/Ctrl+Z
Leave code blocks and inline code spans untouched via Obsidian's syntax tree
extras: Manual install only; npm install needs --legacy-peer-deps because of a peer-version conflict between the obsidian types and CodeMirror packages. Includes keystroke-level tests against a real CodeMirror EditorState.
intentEvidence: I tried a couple of existing autocorrect plugins first, but each rescanned the whole line on every keystroke
motivation: The author tried existing autocorrect plugins, but they rescanned the whole line on every keystroke, re-capitalized deliberate lowercase letters, undid imprecisely, and did more than these specific fixes.
problem: Obsidian lacks Word/LibreOffice-style autocorrect for sentence capitalization, two-initial-capital typos, and dash autoformatting.
summary: As-you-type autocorrect that capitalizes the first letter of sentences, fixes TWo INitial CApitals typos, and converts hyphens into en or em dashes.
